name: Muskingum County, OH
findings: Muskingum County has 310 nonprofit organizations. 131 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 113 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Muskingum County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Economic development organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 10 economic development organizations here list membership, compared with about 3 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.
